title: helm: private values templating, init hooks, and upgrade/rollback enhancements
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Helm chart: stabilize private values templating and init hooks; Improve upgrade and rollback checks for private deployments; Add values.schema.json and examples for private installer; No runtime breaking changes expected.
commits: Add values.schema.json and validate during lint step
Introduce templating helpers for private-specific values and nodeselectors
Refactor init jobs into separate templates and add post-install cleanup hook
Add upgrade/rollback test harness and pre-flight checks
Fix: handle nil tolerations value in templating
review_comments: Diego: Can we make the templating helpers idempotent when tolerations is null? (requested change)
Priya: Updated helpers to default to [] and added unit tests to cover templating behavior (reply)
Marta: Please add an integration test that simulates a failed upgrade and verifies rollback hook execution (requested change)

description: Context: Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) require more robust Helm chart behavior around templating (node selectors, tolerations, KMS/namespaces), init jobs for database/secret bootstrapping, and deterministic upgrade/rollback semantics. This PR consolidates several changes driven by recent customer installs and an internal upgrade incident. Goal: make chart values/schema clearer, make templating idempotent for optional fields, extract init jobs into reusable hooks, and harden pre-upgrade checks to reduce failed upgrades and enable safe automated rollbacks. Changes included: 1) Add charts/private/values.schema.json - JSON Schema for values.yaml to allow helm lint and CI to catch misconfigurations; this schema covers KMS config, tolerations, nodeSelector, storageClass, and postgres boot settings. 2) Templating helpers - charts/private/templates/_helpers.tpl introduces private.nodeSelector and private.tolerations helpers that gracefully handle null/empty values and merge with per-release overrides. 3) Init jobs refactor - split out charts/private/templates/init-job.yaml and charts/private/templates/post-install-job.yaml; converted heavy init logic into a lightweight Kubernetes Job + configurable backoffLimit; added hooks.yaml for pre-upgrade checks. 4) Upgrade/rollback harness - added charts/private/tests/upgrade-tests.yaml and scripts/rollback-checks.sh to CI so integration-upgrade and e2e-rollback run in pipeline; pre-upgrade hook validates KMS access and DB connectivity and will fail fast to prevent partial upgrades. 5) Examples and docs - charts/private/examples/values.private.example.yaml and docs/upgrade.md explain patterns for air-gapped/private installs, recommended values, and rollback procedures. Testing: Ran helm-lint with new schema (fixes several previously uncaught issues), unit tests for templating helpers, and integration upgrade/rollback CI that had one transient e2e-rollback failure (flaky networking); rerun passed. Performance/behavior: templating change avoids rendering heavy empty arrays which previously caused invalid manifests in some edge cases; init jobs now use smaller images and have a configurable timeout to avoid blocking upgrades. Review summary: Diego requested idempotent templating which is implemented; Marta requested integration tests for rollback path which were added; Samir confirmed CI stability and approved. CI: initial CI run failed e2e-rollback due to a flaky network in the test harness; re-run passed and full pipeline green. Files changed: See changed_files metadata. Merge: Squash-merged to main after approvals. Follow-ups: track ENG-2891 to migrate remaining charts to values.schema.json and INF-1220 to extend upgrade harness to dedicated (reserved) environment tests.
